output.narrative:
Revenue dropped by -9.39 (-0.0332), primarily driven by fill_rate, which contributed -16.0 to the revenue delta with a relative change of -0.056. 

The fill rate drop was heavily concentrated in os_version=Android 12, with an explanatory power of 0.935 and a lift of 7.35. Drilling deeper into Android 12, the movement was broad-based and proportional across all device models (e.g., device_model=Redmi Note 12 showed a lift of 1.01). 

Other dimensions such as ad_format were checked and ruled out, as seen in ad_format=video with a lift of 1.03.
